title: TICKET create
description: The body of POST /projects/api/work, less its archetype ("archetype": "TICKET" is added beside these). The status is minted REPORTED by the writer.

impetus.description: Why a ticket came about, in the reporter's words; usually one sentence.

assignee.description: Who is looking at it; free text.

acceptanceCriteria.description: What the work is accepted against, in order: short Markdown statements. The whole list is written at once; an empty list (or null on a patch) clears it. Frozen from READY_FOR_DEV on: restating the same list passes, a changed one is a 409.

items.description: Each item is one line of Markdown: not blank, no line break, at most one '.', and fewer than 20 whitespace characters.

project.description: The project the new TICKET goes in: its id or its slug.
